sections.title: 1 Basic vocabulary
sections.content: Translate these words into your own language:

questions.content: baby
questions.explanation: Từ chỉ em bé mới sinh.

questions.content: child
questions.explanation: Từ chỉ trẻ em nói chung.

questions.content: teenager
questions.explanation: Chỉ người ở độ tuổi từ 13 đến 19.

questions.content: young
questions.explanation: Chỉ độ tuổi còn trẻ.

questions.content: adult
questions.explanation: Người trưởng thành.

questions.content: middle-aged
questions.explanation: Độ tuổi giữa thanh niên và tuổi già.

questions.content: old
questions.explanation: Chỉ người có tuổi.

questions.content: generation
questions.explanation: Tập hợp những người sinh ra cùng một thời kỳ.

sections.title: 2 Ages
sections.content: Match the expressions on the left with those on the right:

questions.content: 1. She's 3 days old. -> [9]
questions.explanation: Trẻ sơ sinh (mới sinh 3 ngày).

questions.content: 2. She's 18 months. -> [10]
questions.explanation: Trẻ mới biết đi (18 tháng tuổi).
Vẫn là một đứa trẻ (8 tuổi).
Thanh thiếu niên (14 tuổi).
Người trưởng thành (20 tuổi).

options: f. He's in his early forties.
j. He's in his late twenties.
questions.explanation: Cuối những năm 20 tuổi (28 tuổi).
questions.correctAnswer: j. He's in his late twenties.

questions.explanation: Giữa những năm 30 tuổi (35 tuổi).
Tuổi trung niên (48 tuổi).
Đầu những năm 40 tuổi (42 tuổi).
questions.correctAnswer: f. He's in his early forties.

questions.explanation: Khá lớn tuổi, già (85 tuổi).

sections.title: 3 A two-year-old boy
sections.content: Look at this example: They are all 10 years old. > They're all ten-year-olds. / He's two years old. > I've got a two-year-old son. Re-write these examples in a similar way:

questions.content:
1. My son is eleven.
I've got an [19]
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ chỉ tuổi ghép bằng dấu gạch ngang.

questions.content:
2. We've got a daughter of six.
We've got a [20]
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ chỉ tuổi ghép không có 's'.

questions.content:
3. Their baby's only two months old.
They've got a [21]
questions.explanation: Chữ month không có 's' vì đã thành tính từ ghép.

questions.content:
4. I teach kids of seven and eight.
I teach [22]
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ số nhiều thêm 's'.

questions.content:
5. Most of them were only sixteen.
They were mostly [23]
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ số nhiều thêm 's'.

questions.content:
6. The boy the police arrested was only nine!
He was only a [24]
questions.explanation: Dùng như một danh từ độc lập số ít.

sections.title: 4 Expressions with 'age'
sections.content: Use these words to complete these expressions with 'age':

questions.content: 1. the [25] age as (me)
questions.explanation: Cụm: the same age as (cùng độ tuổi với).

questions.content: 2. when I was [26] age
questions.explanation: Bằng tuổi bạn.

questions.content: 3. people [27] all ages
questions.explanation: Mọi lứa tuổi.

questions.content: 4. when you [28] to my age
questions.explanation: Khi bạn đến tuổi của tôi.

questions.content: 5. at the age [29] 43
questions.explanation: Ở độ tuổi 43.

questions.content: 6. you don't [30] your age
questions.explanation: Trông không giống tuổi thật.

questions.content: 7. a [31] of his age
questions.explanation: Một đứa trẻ trạc tuổi cậu ấy.

questions.content: 8. [32] your age
questions.explanation: Ở độ tuổi của bạn.

questions.content: a. Do you think you should be smoking [33]? I mean, you're only 15.
options: when you get to my age
questions.explanation: Ở độ tuổi của bạn.

questions.content: b. You're lucky to have the chance to go to university. [34] I had to get a job and start earning some money.
questions.explanation: Khi tôi bằng tuổi bạn.

questions.content: c. John F. Kennedy became one of the youngest Presidents of the United States [35].
questions.explanation: Ở độ tuổi 43.

questions.content: d. Isn't Peter home yet? A [36] should be in bed by 10 at the latest!
questions.explanation: Đứa trẻ ở tuổi nó.

questions.content: e. The great thing about roller-blading is that it appeals to [37] young and old.
questions.explanation: Người ở mọi lứa tuổi.

questions.content: f. Our son is [38] the boy next door. They're in the same class.
questions.explanation: Cùng độ tuổi với.

questions.content: g. You're not really 50, are you? I don't believe it. [39].
questions.explanation: Trông không già như tuổi thật.

questions.content: h. [40] you'll realise there's more to life than going clubbing and riding motorbikes.
questions.explanation: Khi đến tuổi của tôi.
questions.correctAnswer: When you get to my age

sections.title: 5 The generation gap
sections.content: Use the following expressions in the sentences below:

questions.content: 1. Many older people think that [41] are only interested in money.
questions.explanation: Thế hệ trẻ.

questions.content: 2. My wife is ten years older than me, but [42] has never been a problem.
questions.explanation: Sự chênh lệch/Khoảng cách tuổi tác.

questions.content: 3. You can't expect me to use the internet! People [43] grew up without telephones!
questions.explanation: Thuộc thế hệ của tôi.

questions.content: 4. My husband and I can't stand the music our children play or their taste in clothes. I suppose it's just [44].
questions.explanation: Khoảng cách thế hệ.

sections.title: 6 He's very mature for his age
sections.content: Use the following words in the dialogues below:

questions.content:
1. Jane's only two years old, but she can count up to ten.
> Really? She sounds very [45] for her age.
questions.explanation: Sáng dạ, thông minh so với lứa tuổi.

questions.content:
2. Peter's only 14, but he's nearly as tall as me.
> Yes, he's quite [46] for his age, isn't he?
questions.explanation: Cao lớn so với lứa tuổi.

questions.content:
3. Grand-dad plays tennis three times a week.
> I know. He's very [47] for his age.
questions.explanation: Khỏe mạnh, cân đối so với lứa tuổi.

questions.content:
4. You know, Ruth's 50, but she's still a very attractive woman.
> I know. She looks really [48] for her age.
questions.explanation: Trông thật tuyệt vời so với tuổi.

questions.content:
5. Laura's only 14, but when she puts make-up on, you'd think she was 17.
> Yes, she's very [49] for her age, isn't she?
questions.explanation: Trông trưởng thành, người lớn so với tuổi.

questions.content:
6. My grandmother's 100, but she lives alone and looks after herself. She's amazing!
> Yes, she's quite [50] for her age.
questions.explanation: Thật đáng kinh ngạc, phi thường so với tuổi.

sections.title: 7 Age idioms
sections.content: The following idioms are all about getting old. Complete them using these words:

questions.content: 1. You can't teach an old [51] new tricks.
questions.explanation: Thành ngữ: Không thể dạy một con chó già trò mới (khó thay đổi thói quen).

questions.content: 2. She's the [52] side of 40.
questions.explanation: Nhỉnh hơn, già hơn 40 tuổi một chút.

questions.content: 3. He's [53] the hill.
questions.explanation: Quá dốc bên kia cuộc đời (đã già, qua thời kỳ đỉnh cao).

questions.content: 4. He's [54] on a bit now.
questions.explanation: Bắt đầu già đi (getting on a bit).

questions.content: a. John will never change the way he does things. [55]
options: You can't teach an old dog new tricks.
questions.explanation: Áp dụng thành ngữ phù hợp ngữ cảnh.
questions.correctAnswer: You can't teach an old dog new tricks.

questions.content: b. In professional football, you're [56] at 35.
questions.explanation: Áp dụng thành ngữ phù hợp ngữ cảnh.

questions.content: c. I think I'll have to start taking life a bit easier. I am [57] you know!
questions.explanation: Áp dụng thành ngữ phù hợp ngữ cảnh.

questions.content: d. Sheila looks great for her age. You'd never guess she's [58] of 50!
questions.explanation: Áp dụng thành ngữ phù hợp ngữ cảnh.

sections.content: Complete these quotes with the following words:

questions.explanation: Cảm thấy.

questions.content: 2. Life begins at [60].
questions.explanation: Tuổi 40.

questions.content: 3. Women lie about their [61]; men lie about their [62].
questions.explanation: Tuổi tác.
